benefit_text: Banks give crop loans through the Kisan Credit Card. The first year limit covers crop cost and area plus 10% for home needs and 20% for farm repairs. Later years add 10% for higher costs. Term loans cover land and farm tools.
who_can_apply: Farmers who own land and farm alone or together can apply. Tenant farmers and share croppers can also apply. Groups of farmers who work together can also apply.
documents: Two photos and the filled form are needed. ID proof like Aadhar Card is needed. Address proof and land papers from revenue office are needed.
how_to_apply: People can go to the bank website and choose Kisan Credit Card. People fill the form and press submit. The bank gives a reference number and contacts in 3-4 working days.
